task:
Refactor the error handling in this Go package:
1. Read all files to understand the codebase
2. All functions that currently panic should return errors instead
3. Create a custom AppError type with Code (int) and Message (string) fields
4. All error returns should use AppError with appropriate error codes
5. Update calculator_test.go to test all error paths (division by zero, overflow, invalid input)
6. Add a Validate function that checks if an expression string is valid
7. Add a History type that tracks the last 10 calculations with timestamps
8. Write tests for History including overflow (11th calculation replaces oldest)
9. Run all tests and fix any failures
